RiskAuditGuide.title: Risk & Audit Guide
RiskAuditGuide.subtitle: Three short steps to the right check level.

step1.question: Recently imported, or driven in Latvia for longer?
step1.hint: This decides how deep the history check should go.

step2.title: Listing link
step2.hint: Optional for a paid order. Required for the free short review.

free.title: Short listing review
free.body: 3–5 sentences by email in 24–48h about what is visible in the listing. No database / VIN analysis — not an audit and not a consultation.
free.needUrl: To get the short review, paste a link in the previous step.

mini.title: PROVIN MINI
mini.body: Compact check; typically for cars used longer in Latvia.

audits.title: PROVIN AUDITS
audits.body: Full audit; typically for recent imports.

form.boundary: You get a 3–5 sentence look at the public listing (text, price signals, visible risks) within 24–48h. No database or VIN analysis — this is not an audit.

success.title: Request received.
success.body: We’ll reply by email within 24–48h with a short look at the listing (not data analysis). If you need a deeper check — order an audit now.

errors.listing: Paste a valid link to a specific listing.
errors.rateLimited: A short review was already requested for this email in the last 7 days.
errors.listingRateLimited: A short review was already requested for this listing in the last 7 days.
errors.ipRateLimited: Several requests were already submitted from this device / network today. Try again tomorrow or order an audit.
errors.generic: Could not submit. Please try again.
